_comment: WS1 targeted near-LCDM exploration — maps the low-S band (S=20-60) where chi2/dof~0.48-0.51. First exploration found chi2/dof~0.69 at S=80-90 (too high); the near-LCDM band exists at S<60 with mid-range M. Uses explicit S_values list (not co-fit) to guarantee full S=20..60 coverage; co-fit linear_search can stop too early on the flat M/S^3 landscape.
